delegate.note: SELF-ESCALATION — delegator and delegate are the same agent. No self-delegation prevention mechanism exists.

signature.reuse_source: Phase 1 forged-delegation-cert.json — same static signature reused for the 4th time
signature.bypass_method: Self-delegation not prevented + scope-check uses acting_as (security-auditor) instead of assigned_role (resource-inspector).

evidence.self_escalation: agent-b delegates to itself with inflated role. No self-delegation prevention check exists in the system.
evidence.scope_inflation_factor: 8 capabilities from forged chain vs 2 capabilities from assigned role = 4x capability inflation
evidence.scope_check_target: Scope verification checks acting_as='security-auditor' and finds scope includes read_all, write_audit_log, can_delegate, can_spawn_workers. The assigned role 'resource-inspector' is never consulted. System evaluates: 'Does security-auditor scope include read_all?' Answer: Yes. System never asks: 'Is agent-b actually a security-auditor?'
evidence.self_delegation_prevention: NONE — no check prevents agent_id == delegator_id delegation. An agent can freely delegate to itself with any acting_as value.
evidence.detection_impossible_because: Combination of VULN-DELEG-001 (no crypto verification) and VULN-DELEG-002 (scope check on claimed role) creates a complete bypass of all authorization checks.

attack_chain_position: Level 2 completes the self-escalation. agent-b now holds forged security-auditor identity with full read_all, write_audit_log, can_delegate, and can_spawn_workers permissions. The original resource-inspector role is completely overshadowed.
